claims.source: Alberta Merged Wetland Inventory (AMWI) + Sentinel-2 NDWI/MNDWI (Planetary Computer) + Sentinel-1 RTC (Planetary Computer)
claims.allowed_claim: Screening only for presence of open water or wet depressions. Not a regulatory wetland delineation, permanent water guarantee, or Water Act determination. Small detections require site walk verification.

payload.disclaimer: Small water detections combine inventory polygons with 10 m satellite indices. Low–medium confidence features may be seasonal pools, seeps, or false positives. Always verify on a site walk before design or regulatory decisions. Never treat pixel detections as Alberta Wetland Policy delineations.
